verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of chart of accounts customization, account types, sub-accounts, or class/tag dimensions—only marketing content on invoicing, reconciliation, integrations, and AI features. This is a well-known QuickBooks Online capability, but absence of evidence for it in this pack means it cannot be credited; missing for 10: any docs on account type selection, sub-account creation, or class/location/tag tracking features.
